notes.title: SLAUGHTER Mode Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220930/03da958b165327be948a0055d42d3ddde055d7ce.png[/img][h1]Welcome to SLAUGHTER Mode![/h1]

The new Hard mode can be accessed by those who have completed the main campaign.

[h2][h1]FEATURES:[/h1][/h2]

[list]
[*] This is a continuation of the story, including a new ending.
[*] Death is final. No respawns or saves.
[*] Meat Man is stronger and faster.
[*] And more...
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]

- Archivist achievement is no longer granted 1 note early.
- Fixed a softlock situation due to a door button not being interactable in the lab laser room.
- Fixed an issue where Meat Man would run into, and get stuck standing in front of, the slicer gap during his fleeing state in Meat World.
- Other small bugs.

If you have any questions or want to report bugs, send an email to [b]contact@bassettinteractive.com[/b]
